payload.rationale: The obligation asks whether the Part I WET table frequency (Once/Quarter) together with footnote (*9) independently establish the applicable WET monitoring frequency and conditions, or whether determining applicable monitoring requires resolving PART II including the frequency reduction option. Footnote (*9) states that monitoring begins on the permit effective date but explicitly directs the reader to PART II for additional WET monitoring and reporting conditions and a frequency reduction option. That cross-reference is positive evidence in the packet that Part I plus (*9) do not independently establish the full applicable monitoring regime; frequency and conditions may be modified by PART II provisions not present in this packet. REJECT therefore rejects the independence claim without inferring closed-world facts from PART II's absence. The packet does not supply PART II text or Federal FY2025 calendar mapping, so the specific content of PART II conditions remains unresolved, but the structural dependency on PART II is established by (*9) itself.
